statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has a diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome
Diagnosis codes I49.5, G45.9, and R00.2 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary for this patient
The service directly supports the diagnoses by documenting the association between palpitations and cerebral ischemic episodes
